{{Nickname}}
The '''MODS System''' is the name given for the four important principles within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], derived from the first letter of each of the rules. The principles are Mettle; Obedience; Discipline; and Selflessness.

Although it was intended to be geared towards all within the Imperial Army, most of the high-ranking officers only pay lip service to the code and otherwise view them as hollow words, resulting in former Imperial officer-turned Rebel officer [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] giving it the derisive nickname "Frauds System," and likewise noting this on his notes in the ''Imperial Handbook''.
